scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src='src';function walk(d){const r=[];for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())r.push(...walk(p));else if(/\.tsx?$/.test(f))r.push(p);}return r;}let ok=true;for(const f of walk(src)){const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const m=c.match(/^export\s+default/gm);if(m&&m.length>1){console.error('DUPLICATE export default in '+f+' ('+m.length+' occurrences)');ok=false;}}if(!ok)process.exit(1);"
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && npm run typecheck && vite build
